text: My car won't start this morning, the starter only clicks. I'm at home in the driveway.
Flat tyre on the A9 near Ingolstadt, we are on the hard shoulder with two small children in the car.
Keys locked inside the car at the supermarket car park in Passau. No hurry, my partner is bringing the spare key in two hours if you cannot come.
Hit a deer on a country road outside Freyung, front of the car is smashed and the radiator is leaking. Car cannot be driven.
Engine warning light came on and the car lost power on the A3 near Regensburg, I managed to stop at the next exit. I am alone and fine.
Mein Auto springt nicht an, die Batterie ist wohl leer. Ich stehe zu Hause in der Garage.
Reifen geplatzt auf der A8 Richtung Salzburg, wir stehen auf dem Standstreifen, meine Mutter (84) ist dabei.
My father collapsed in our hotel in Rimini and was taken to hospital. The doctors only speak Italian. What do we do?
Our camper van broke down in Lyon. It will be in the workshop for five days. We need a hotel and a way to continue to Spain.
Electric car shows 0 km range, I am stuck on the B12 between Passau and Freyung. It is getting dark.
Strong smell of petrol from under the car, I stopped in a car park in Deggendorf and turned the engine off.
I lost my car key while hiking near the Koenigssee. The car is at the main car park.
Gearbox makes grinding noises and no gear engages any more. Car is at the office car park in Munich, it has to go to a workshop.
Passport and wallet stolen in Zagreb, flight home is tomorrow. Need help with documents and money.
Motorrad springt nicht an, nur ein Klicken. Stehe an einer Raststaette an der A92.
Tyre pressure warning, the rear right tyre is slowly losing air. I am at home, can someone check it today?
My daughter broke her arm skiing in Ischgl, Austria. She is in the clinic and we want to know if she can be brought home.
Car stopped in the middle of the tunnel on the A7, hazard lights are on, I cannot restart it.
The ferry from Ancona to Patras was cancelled because of a storm. We are four people with a car and need another connection.
Child locked inside the car in the sun at a petrol station in Straubing, the key is inside too!
After a minor collision in Landshut both front tyres are damaged and the wheel is bent. The car cannot be driven.
Lights were left on the whole night, now the car is dead. It is parked in front of my flat in Vilshofen.
Wir haben Durchfall und hohes Fieber seit zwei Tagen in Antalya, das Hotel kennt keinen Arzt. Wir brauchen einen deutschsprachigen Arzt.
Coolant temperature in the red, steam from the bonnet. I am on a country road near Zwiesel with my two kids.
Rental car in Mallorca will not start, the rental office is closed until Monday. We need to get to the airport on Sunday.
